title: Borrow underflow criterion
statement: For every Boolean word, subtracting an incoming borrow flag set to true produces a final borrow flag equal to true if and only if the word's little-endian value is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean word
replaced:
Subtracting a set borrow flag from a word underflows if and only if the word's
little-endian value is $0$.
